claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Isoxsuprine is a beta-adrenergic agonist with weak CDK1 inhibition (IC50 ~2.9 uM) and cationic amphiphilic properties, so at 2.5 uM it is expected to produce little or no selective cytotoxicity, with any weak killing likely reflecting nonspecific lysosomal/physicochemical stress rather than a targeted antiproliferative mechanism.
